name: The Alliance Needs More Roast Raptor!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Roast Raptor!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hi again adventurer. I can tell you're very excited about all of this. So I suppose you want to bring me another twenty roast raptor. Great. Well you do that. I guess I'll see you when you get back.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hi again, adventurer. I can tell you're very excited about all of this. So I suppose you want to bring me another twenty roast raptor? Great. Well you do that. I guess I'll see you when you get back.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wow, you're a real go-getter. You make me tired just looking at you. Anyway, thanks from the Alliance and all that. I'll make sure that all of that dead meat gets packed away. I guess you could check back with me later to see if we still need more of it, though it's starting to stink up the place if you ask me.
